publishedDeadlines.note: Annual date for following August; funded-faculty requests can allow other reviews.

applicationFee.note: International fee; central domestic $65 (Biology page still lists $50). McNair waiver; departments may offer limited competitive codes. Biology also lists prior K-State undergraduate research participation. Confirm international eligibility before payment.

english.toefl: 100 iBT; FAQ speaking 22; current-scale equivalent not supplied
english.note: Biology thresholds exceed central minimum; official scores within two years. Listed English-country or US-degree exemptions; confirm current TOEFL scale with Biology.

documents: Uploaded transcripts and degree certificates; certified English translations for international records
requirements.note: Four-year bachelor equivalent; research experience expected and matching faculty named. Direct lab entry or first-semester 2–3 rotations according to area. Admission committee makes final decision. Department says no fixed GPA, whereas FAQ cites 3.0 for regular admission; confirm exceptions.

funding.note: Full support for degree duration conditional on satisfactory progress; tuition and living stipend. Approximately $27,300 undated stipend stated equally for domestic/international students.
